verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe self-hosting/BYOC deployments giving full LlamaCloud capabilities within customer infrastructure, including Kubernetes/Helm deployment on AWS/Azure/GCP, plus enterprise deployment options (managed SaaS, single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting, regional endpoints). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted deployment actually running (no community reports), and details on licensing/open-source availability of the self-hosted code vs. it being a gated enterprise offering.
